description:
Problem: .github/workflows/oracle-review.yml is a no-op notification. Its permission-less review-event job runs on pull_request_review submitted, edited and dismissed (oracle-review.yml:5-7; the run name carries the action, :3), and the oracle-gate workflow_run bridge (oracle-gate.yml:12-13 subscribes to oracle-verdict and oracle-review; the bridge job is :147-177) turns each completion into a gate dispatch. It was kept because oracle-verdict runs started by a comment, dispatch or schedule carry develop's tip SHA, so their completion cannot be mapped to a PR. Since #3436, oracle-verdict's post job dispatches oracle-gate for the PR and head right after posting its review (oracle-verdict.yml:264-269 posts the review, :325-336 dispatches the gate). That post job is the only place oracle reviews are posted. The gate reads the pull request, changed files, the policy, oracle reviews including each review's current body, oracle threads, the base-change date and stand-in comments (oracle_gate.py:128-143; oracle_review_check.py:122-180); it does not read human reviews. The notification's only unique inputs are therefore an edit or a dismissal of an oracle review by someone other than the oracle. It costs a workflow run plus a bridge run per review (62 oracle-review runs in the 2.6 hours after #3429 merged), and a pull request already controls it: GitHub runs the copy in the PR's test merge, so a PR can delete or alter it.

Since owner decision Q9 (2026-10-26), oracle-gate-from-verdict-job-20261026 posts oracle-gate from the verdict run and leaves thread resolution to the ruleset, so everything that existed only to refresh oracle-gate after review events is now dead weight: the notification workflow, the workflow_run bridge, the gate push sweep and the pr-arm refresh.

Outcome: oracle-review.yml deleted; oracle-gate.yml has no workflow_run bridge and no push sweep (cron safety sweep kept); make pr-arm and make pr-arm-remote no longer dispatch oracle-gate; tests and docs describe the verdict run as the gate's poster.

Decision gates:
1. Evidence first: record five verdict runs after oracle-gate-from-verdict-job-20261026 merged that posted oracle-gate in-run (run ids). Any run that failed to post stops this item.
2. Inventory (LSP references and grep) every bridge, push-sweep and pr-arm-refresh reference before editing; record it in context.
3. Review edits and dismissals no longer need a gate refresh: after oracle-gate-reject-edited-reviews-20261026 an edited or deleted oracle review never counts. Confirm that at implementation time; if not true, stop.

Scope:
- Delete .github/workflows/oracle-review.yml and tests/unit/workflows/test_oracle_review_workflow.py; remove that test's line from tests/unit/ledger_cutover_files.txt.
- .github/workflows/oracle-gate.yml: remove the workflow_run trigger and the bridge job entirely, and the push trigger; keep issue_comment (stand-ins and adjudications), pull_request_target head and base changes, workflow_dispatch and the cron safety sweep.
- scripts/pr_arm.py: remove the oracle-gate refresh added by #3485 and its tests; scripts/remote_closeout.py:575: remove pr-arm-remote's refresh and its tests.
- The gate's waiting messages: no manual 'gh workflow run' or 'rerun this check' instruction; the gate re-evaluates on its own events.
- Tests that load the file: test_oracle_gate_workflow.py:116-120 (assert oracle-gate.yml has no workflow_run or push trigger), test_oracle_verdict_workflow.py:17 and the test at :62-67 (keep the :349 assertion), test_release_pr_check_scope.py:28-30 (delete that test).
- Keep the .github/workflows/oracle-review.yml entries in .github/soundness-paths.txt:89 and .github/oracle-reviewers.yml:96 so a re-created file is still soundness-reviewed; test_soundness_paths.py:67 is a predicate case and stays.
- _project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py: remove the standalone checker command (_parse_args, main and the __main__ block) after LSP references show only tests call them; update tests/unit/scripts/test_oracle_review_check.py and the dev-loop-property-ledger rows that describe them.
- Docs: docs/internal/oracle-review-v2.md :617-641, :715-717 and :768-771; docs/internal/repo-admin-settings.md:70-71; docs/internal/soundness-drain.md:38-42; docs/internal/dev-loop-property-ledger.md:84 and :120; supersede the 'keeps its path and name' clause in _project/decisions/oracle-review-check-retired-2026-10-24.md:52-54.
- Leave unchanged: tests that use 'oracle-review' only as a sample check name (test_check_suites.py, test_pr_rerun.py, test_pr_landing.py, test_remote_closeout.py, test_pr_arm.py, the ruleset tests); comment-policy tests that reject oracle-review as evidence, including the fixture at test_comment_policy.py:2542; soundness_merge_digest.py's 'oracle-review' signal and its ORACLE_PATH test fixture; the 'oracle-review:' prefix of the gate's status messages.

Item guardrails: no change to the verdict decision, the oracle_gate.py decision or stand-in handling beyond removing refresh paths; do not ask the owner to disable the workflow in repository settings.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, code) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build recorded in that item (SHA-256 fa41b27d434380e99b713e4f9ced0f73eb1fc0c409fdf23a57c119971d24bac5, from https://build.stencil.so/d/omp/20261017-231446-291e055/omp-darwin-arm64), verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp. Close out only with oracle SHIP on the exact head, every oracle thread answered (reply naming the fixing SHA, then resolve) and make pr-arm; never raw gh pr merge or a ruleset or settings change, and never a stand-in, adjudication or backoff reset unless the owner names the PR and head (and the finding) in the current request after an Owner instruction comment. Never edit, delete, dismiss or minimise an oracle review, review comment or commit status, and never post a commit status by hand. Run /oracle-review only on a pending or absent head, or after a Dispute: reply with file:line counter-evidence; never to re-roll a decided head. Do not close, reopen, rerun or rebase other PRs. Until oracle-gateway-cloud-builder-access-20261025 merges, publish only from the owner's Mac. Rollback: if a change to the verdict or gate workflows or to the local review breaks its first live run after merge in a way that blocks other PRs, stop, run make trunk-revert PR=<n>, and report to the owner, who chooses between an absence stand-in and the broken-oracle-gate procedure. Never print tokens, keys, or the gateway URL or hostname; never spend model quota outside the review harness. Owner decisions are recorded in context and in the decisions file; a step that would contradict one stops and asks the owner.
